finding: Cell-by-cell comparison of all 27 cached Skadi 1-arc-second tiles N46-N48/E009-E017 with SRTMGL1 v3 (ESA STEP mirror): 0.9931-0.99986 of valid cells identical, mean absolute difference <= 0.025 m, 99th percentile 0 m (table: reports/anfaelligkeit_at_v01/dem_skadi_vs_srtm.json). Over Austria the Skadi tiles used by V0.4 are SRTMGL1 v3, not the data.gv.at laser-scan DGM.
correction: config dem.sensitivity.source describes Skadi as 'based on the data.gv.at laser-scan DGM'. That description is factually wrong. Skadi height provenance is effectively SRTM (February 2000) for >= 99.3 % of cells.
design_change: none. Both registered variants run unchanged. Consequence for interpretation: the two variants differ essentially only in the positive set (srtm: known year >= 2001; skadi: all positives incl. unknown year and Thiersee 1970), not in the height data. The skadi variant stays a labelled sensitivity analysis because the provenance (Feb 2000) is not demonstrably before the unknown-year and 1970 events.
